style: Anime background art, painterly cel style with clean linework, Japanese summer festival at night, deep indigo sky, warm glowing orange paper lanterns, wide composition. Original artwork. No text, no letters, no kanji, no signage writing, no watermark.

jobs.prompt: A festival street at night seen from the middle of the path: rows of game and food stalls with cloth curtains, strings of paper lanterns overhead fading into the distance, four young people in yukata walking away from the viewer on the right side, the left side darker and calmer.
A festival prize stall with three tiers of shelves full of plush toys and trinkets, ring-toss rings hanging on hooks, lantern light, no people.
A festival stall where finished paintings on lantern paper hang from strings like laundry, brushes and ink pots on the counter, warm light, no people.
A festival mask stall with rows of colorful festival masks hanging on a wooden wall, one fox mask in the center slightly turned away, warm light, no people.
The end of a festival street at night, a dark forest path past the last lanterns, a huge full moon over the trees, a single wolf mask hanging on a post, eerie and quiet, no people.
A festival fortune stall with a wooden counter covered in folded paper fortune slips in a grid, two tassels, one red and one green, hanging from the counter, warm light, no people.
